# Middle Class Musicians

> Middle Class Musicians (MCM Studio) is a recording and music production studio in Uttam Nagar, New Delhi, India.

## Canonical website

- https://middleclassmusicians.in/

## Core services

- Vocal recording
- Music production
- Mixing and mastering
- Custom beat production
- Songwriting and arrangement support
- Music production and AI music courses
- Artist management
- Video production
